title: Quantum Computing with Qiskit & Python (PYTH_191_S1 to PYTH_191_S8)

slides.title: Quantum Circuits in Qiskit
slides.prompt: Qiskit allows building and simulating quantum circuits using qubits, quantum gates, and measurement operations.
slides.codeSnippet:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])

slides.title: Hadamard Gate Application
slides.prompt: Fill in the QuantumCircuit method used to put a qubit into a superposition state.

slides.title: Entanglement via CNOT Gate
slides.prompt: Which combination of quantum gates creates a maximally entangled Bell state from two ground-state qubits?
options: Hadamard gate on qubit 0 followed by CNOT gate targeting qubit 1
Pauli-X gate on both qubits 0 and 1
Two consecutive Hadamard gates on qubit 0
Measurement gate applied to qubit 0 followed by Pauli-Z gate
slides.correctAnswer: Hadamard gate on qubit 0 followed by CNOT gate targeting qubit 1

slides.title: Simulating Circuits with Aer
slides.prompt: Fill in the module method used to execute quantum circuits on local statevector simulators.
slides.codeSnippet:
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator

simulator = AerSimulator()
job = simulator.___(circuit)

slides.title: Qubit Measurement & Collapse
slides.prompt: What happens to a qubit in a superposition state when a measurement operation is performed?
options: Its wave function collapses into a deterministic classical state (0 or 1)
It permanently splits into two parallel virtual quantum states
It doubles its physical energy level inside the circuit
It reverses its execution direction back to the initial state
slides.correctAnswer: Its wave function collapses into a deterministic classical state (0 or 1)

slides.title: Transpilation for Hardware Target
slides.prompt: Fill in the Qiskit function used to optimize and map generic quantum circuits to specific backend topology.
slides.codeSnippet:
from qiskit import ___

compiled_circuit = transpile(qc, backend)

slides.title: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE)
slides.prompt: What is the hybrid classical-quantum architecture behind VQE algorithms?
options: A quantum circuit evaluates parameterized states while a classical optimizer tunes parameters iteratively
The quantum processor handles classical SQL queries while the CPU compiles quantum circuits
A classical neural network executes gate operations without quantum hardware
Quantum hardware compiles binary C++ source files into bytecode
slides.correctAnswer: A quantum circuit evaluates parameterized states while a classical optimizer tunes parameters iteratively
